stem: This excerpt illustrates Harding's campaign promise to be a president who would —

options.label: A
options.text: help the country recover from the turmoil of the previous decade

options.label: B
options.text: refuse to allow the continuation of laissez-faire economic policies

options.label: C
options.text: use diplomacy to establish alliances with other countries

options.label: D
options.text: improve economic growth by promoting unrestricted immigration

visual_elements: America's present need is not heroics but healing; . . . not revolution but restoration; . . . not submergence in internationality but sustainment in triumphant nationality. —Warren G. Harding, presidential campaign speech, 1920
